user_steering: Rare exceptions may be outliers; do substantially deeper EDA and reflection rather than overinterpreting a universal-rule counterexample.
allowed: evaluation of existing frozen prediction arrays
predeclared deterministic causal output transforms without coefficient fitting
forbidden: coefficient search or promoted tuned filters
future data or labels in any deployable predictor
retrospective_scope: Targets, later input-event distances and label-defined partitions may be used only to describe fixed data or compute explicitly noncausal oracle diagnostics. Such diagnostics are not deployable predictors, improvements, or Bayes ceilings.
predeclared_questions: How rare are exceptions under relevant denominators and clipped target weights?
Does a missed change produce persistent clock-reconstruction distortion?
Does holding emitted outputs help or harm existing models while leaving their hidden-state computation intact?
How much weighted prediction variance lies within constant-clipped-label runs?
Which model mechanisms are actually distinguished by these observations?
scientific_limits: no model-quality claim from counts alone
sequence/bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on fixed predictions, not fit variability
correlated seeds and related teacher/student models are not independent mechanisms

comparison_matrix.selection: documented lineage before scores; full finite-RG coverage and shared intersection established before grading
comparison_matrix.policy_detail: Both raw-then-clip and clipped-input EMA orders fixed before scoring in the prediction inventory; alpha=1/tau.

publication: Keep R1 sources and results frozen; append new records and publish a coherent R2 research snapshot without new fits. Existing proposal branches retain their R1 base.
objective_mode: competition: identify the next informative mechanism test; no candidate promotion
verification_tier: deterministic descriptive EDA and exact fixed-array intervention; exposed empirical surface, no generalization confirmation
additional_diagnostics_before_grades: Within/between-sequence covariance and variance decomposition from saved six raw moments, independently checked against centered canonical scores.
Optional cross-model weighted prediction, clipped residual and within-label-run fluctuation correlations; no fitted correction or ensemble coefficient selection.
